decisions.reason: The relaunch SEO service has kept its own page for two years, which signals satisfactory results. It also fits the firm's core shop-relaunch business and needs little dedicated slack, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for other uses of the resources.

The SEO workshops are new and their results are still uncertain. They draw on existing marketing expertise at low cost in a growing industry, so management has enough slack to keep them while they are evaluated against aspirations.
